spec2def(openglcfg.cpl openglcfg.spec)

# openglcfg.cpl is all Rust (openglcfg-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/openglcfg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# openglcfg.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/openglcfg-rust/src/openglcfg/openglcfg.rs)
# general.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/openglcfg-rust/src/openglcfg/general.rs)
add_cargo_module(openglcfg openglcfg-cargo openglcfg.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE openglcfg-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
